title: A Uniform for the Atlas
author: Elodie Blackwood
blurb: Theo Okafor, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
